description: 한국수자원공사_하수처리장 일일 수질 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수자원공사. 한국수자원공사가 위탁 운영중인 하수처리장의 유입수 및 방류수의 일일 수질현황입니다. 본 자료를 통해 하수처리장의 수질 관리 현황을 점검할 수 있고, 연구자와 산업계는 수질 변동 특성과 오염 저감 효과를 분석하는 데 활용할 수 있습니다. 또한 본 데이터는 수질 개선 정책 수립, 연구 분석, 시설 운영 관리... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국수자원공사. Its tags are 하수도 수질, 일일수질, 하수도 수질현황, 방류수, 수질현황. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
